dm.title: 🏴‍☠️ Crew muster – week {week} ({range})
dm.question:
Ahoy, matey! Which days will ye be aboard the ship (in the office) {when}?
Pick every day that applies, arrr:
dm.status.empty: ⏳ No answer stowed yet. No days picked + Save = no days aboard.
dm.hint: Ye can change course until {deadline}. Changes only count once ye click *Aye, save it!*
dm.superseded: ↪️ This message has walked the plank and been replaced. Use the latest message below, savvy?
dm.away.button: 🌴 I'm on shore leave this week
dm.away: 🌴 Ye be marked as on shore leave this week. No reminders will reach ye, and the summary lists ye as away.
dm.away.hint: Comin' aboard after all? Until {deadline} ye can cancel yer shore leave and pick yer days.
dm.away.answered: Ye've already given yer answer and this week's voyage be under way, matey! Use 🌴 Plan shore leave to log yer leave from today on.
dm.closed.away: Ye were on shore leave this week.
reminder.text: ⏰ Avast! Tell the Cap'n which days ye'll be aboard the ship (in the office) in week {week} – by {deadline}, or it's the plank for ye!
summary.title: 🏴‍☠️ Who be aboard – week {week} ({range})
summary.responses_away: *Answers:* {answered} of {total} crew members · {away} on shore leave
summary.unreachable: ⚠️ Message lost at sea, couldn't reach: {names}
summary.project: ⭐ Fancy this bot, matey? <{url}|Award it a star on GitHub>
timeoff.title: Shore leave
timeoff.intro: On shore leave days ye get no poll and no reminders. If ye be ashore a whole week, the channel summary lists ye as away.
timeoff.none: No shore leave planned. All hands on deck!
timeoff.error.order: The last day can't be before the first day, ye landlubber.
timeoff.error.past: The first day can't be in the past – no sailin' backwards in time!
timeoff.error.too_far: Shore leave can be planned at most one year ahead.
timeoff.error.failed: Blimey, that didn't work. Try again in a moment.
language.name: Pirate (English)
language.title: Language
language.intro: In which tongue shall I send ye yer poll, reminders and replies, matey? The channel summary stays in the crew's tongue.
language.label: Language
reply.try_again: Blimey, that didn't work. Try again in a moment.
reply.save_unavailable: Can't stow anything right now, the seas be rough. Try again in a moment.
reply.save_failed: Yer choice couldn't be saved. Try again, matey.
reply.unreadable: Yer choice couldn't be read – looks like a soggy map. Try again.
reply.poll_gone: This poll be gone to Davy Jones' locker.
reply.not_participant: Ye be not signed on for this poll.
reply.stale_dm: Use the latest poll message, matey.
reply.stale_summary: Use this week's latest overview, matey.
reply.closed: 🔒 The poll has been closed since {deadline}.
reply.closed_no_changes: 🔒 The poll has been closed since {deadline}. No more changin' course.
reply.dm_pending: 📩 Yer poll be already sailin' yer way and should land in yer direct messages shortly.
reply.dm_cooldown: 📩 I just sent ye the poll! Check yer direct messages.
reply.dm_resent: 📩 I'll send ye the poll again by direct message. Yer previous choice be kept safe in the hold.
reply.not_eligible: Ye be not part o' this crew's poll. Questions? Ask the Cap'n who runs the bot.
reply.late_joiner_added: 📩 Welcome aboard! Ye've been added to this week's poll. I'll send it by direct message shortly.
change.swapped: 🔄 Arr, *{name}* changed course: not aboard on {removed}, but on {added} instead!
change.added: 🔄 Arr, *{name}* be comin' aboard on {added} as well!
change.removed: 🔄 Arr, *{name}* won't be aboard on {removed} after all!
change.no_office: 🔄 Arr, *{name}* won't be boardin' the ship this week after all!
change.back: 🔄 Arr, *{name}* be comin' aboard after all: {added}!
